correctness.rationale: For n=x−a the exterior nilpotence identity n³=0 holds in all characteristics, so ranks r1 of L_n and r2 of L_n² determine Jordan block counts b3=r2, b2=r1−2r2, b1=16−2r1+r2. If degree-one part v≠0, split E=ΛU⊕vΛU and use invertible block multiplication to prove r1=8. In odd characteristic n²=2v b(1+α) for w=v∧α+b, rank2 iff v∧w≠0, giving r2=2; in char2 r2=0. For v=0,w≠0 the independent graded images give r1=2+rho(w), r2=1 precisely when odd char and rho(w)=4; degree3 and degree4 only give ranks2 and1. Plücker Grassmannian counts rank2 altern forms R2=(q−1)(q²+1)(q²+q+1), complement rank4 R4=q²(q−1)(q³−1); remaining strata are vector bundles/punctured spaces. Independent F2 exterior algebra left-multiplication matrix elimination tested 3048 elements, including char2 degeneration, not universal proof.
